acceptanceCriteria: the dogfood bind path runs or explicitly records NOT_PRODUCED for the guarding-tests step, with a test
body: Residual from the V1-1266 lane (PR #944, head 5f98009ae, TCQ-V0-062 corvint cem verify --guarding-tests). internal/dogfoodflow never invokes cem verify --guarding-tests, so guarded test-claim plan rows only appear when an agent runs the step by hand; the V1-1266 K1 tally counts held hunks from dogfood changes. Expected: the dogfood bind path offers or runs the step (bounded by its deadline) and retains NOT_PRODUCED when it does not. Actual: no automatic run.
title: dogfoodflow does not run the --guarding-tests producer step
